question: For The Estee Lauder Companies (fiscal year ends June 30), report GAAP gross margin (gross profit / net sales, in %) and GAAP operating margin (operating income (loss) / net sales, in %) for each of its last four reported fiscal quarters as of October 3, 2026. Label each quarter with its fiscal quarter, fiscal year and period-end date. Use GAAP figures as reported (not adjusted/non-GAAP); fourth-quarter results are not separately filed on a 10-Q.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Estee Lauder GAAP margins (Q4 FY2026 derived as FY2026 minus nine months and matching the Q4 release):

- Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) is not separately filed on a 10-Q; its quarterly net sales, gross profit and operating loss are reported in the Q4/FY2026 earnings release (8-K filed 2026-08-19) and reconcile to the FY2026 10-K figures. [4][5]
- Q4 FY2026 GAAP gross margin was disclosed as 75.5% for the three months ended June 30, 2026; calculated from the same inputs it is 75.5%. [4]
- All figures above are GAAP as reported; the company's non-GAAP adjusted gross margin and adjusted operating income (e.g., Adjusted Gross Profit, Non-GAAP of $2,750 million and Adjusted Operating Income, Non-GAAP of $267 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026) are excluded. [4]

claims.claim: Q1 FY2026 (quarter ended September 30, 2025) net sales were $3,481 million
claims.reason: The 10-Q filed 2025-10-30 shows Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax of 3,481,000,000 USD for the period 2025-07-01 to 2025-09-30.

claims.claim: Q1 FY2026 GAAP gross margin was 73.4%
claims.reason: The same 10-Q shows Gross Profit of 2,554,000,000 USD and Revenue of 3,481,000,000 USD. Calculated gross margin = 2,554 / 3,481 = 73.37%, which rounds to 73.4%.

claims.claim: Q1 FY2026 GAAP operating margin was 4.9%
claims.reason: The 10-Q shows Operating Income of 169,000,000 USD. Calculated operating margin = 169 / 3,481 = 4.85%, which rounds to 4.9%.

claims.claim: Q2 FY2026 GAAP gross margin was 76.5%

claims.claim: Q2 FY2026 GAAP operating margin was 9.5%
